summary_1line: Hanuman offers to carry Sita from Lanka, but she refuses, urging him instead to bring Rama so her rescue and Ravana’s defeat occur honorably.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman enlarges his form to mountain size before the astonished Sita beneath the trees of Ashoka grove.
Hanuman kneels offering his shoulders for Sita to ride across the ocean while she stands hesitant among the Ashoka trees.
Sita, tearful yet resolute, refuses Hanuman’s rescue and gestures toward the distant horizon where Rama must come.
